description: Manual regression fixtures for the write-test-cases skill. Each case is a known scenario run by a human before changing skill behaviour.
how_to_run: Not CI-gated — no automated qualitative grader. For each eval: (1) load the prompt into Copilot Chat, (2) generate the CSV, (3) run scripts/validate_csv.py for structural format rules, (4) eyeball the output against the expectations checklist.
maintenance: Keep small and high-signal. Prune stale cases. Update when SKILL.md or requirements change. Don't add cases without a clear regression they guard. Evals 8, 11, and 12 reference wiki pages at your-confluence.example.com; point them at real pages (or local exports) in your own wiki before running.

evals.purpose: Exact wiki formula extraction — skill reads the wiki page for price formulas and uses exact named variables (UnitCost, ReturnedQty, ShippedQty, Rebate, BundleShare, InsuredAmount), not generic placeholders.
evals.prompt: write happy-path test cases for PBI: SHPloc: Change Price in Stock Account Lines of the Primary Ledger Posting. Currently Price defaults to 0. Exceptions require calculating Price from Shp.Allocation.UnitCost. Scope: Return to stock; Partial refund; Bundle split and Bundle merge; Lost parcel claim. From ERP, unit cost is not received — default value = 0.000000. Authoritative source for the exact price formulas — read this before generating (use the confluence-assistant skill): https://your-confluence.example.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=123464&spaceKey=DOCS&title=Stock%2Bposting%2Bprice%2Bformulas
evals.expected_output: A CSV file at qa-output/test-cases/*-test-cases.csv with at least one test case covering each formula group, using the exact price formulas from the linked wiki page (the agent must consult it — do not invent or use generic placeholders). Expected formulas: Return to stock → Price = Shp.Allocation.UnitCost; Partial refund → UnitCost * ABS(ReturnedQty/ShippedQty); Bundle split/Bundle merge → (UnitCost - (Rebate/ReturnedQty)) * ABS(ReturnedQty/ShippedQty) * BundleShare (Rebate=0 for Bundle split); Lost parcel claim → Price = InsuredAmount; ERP → 0.000000 (an additional source path, not a posting-type group). Component = SHP.
